user.title: Enable Banking Setup
user.description:
Enter your Enable Banking API credentials.

**How to get them:**
1. Open [{enablebanking_url}/cp/applications]({enablebanking_url}/cp/applications)
2. Choose **Sandbox** (testing) or **Production**
3. Select **Generate in the browser** for the key
4. Enter an application name (e.g. "Home Assistant Finance")
5. Register exactly this redirect URL: `{redirect_url}`
6. Click **Register** - the private key downloads automatically
7. Copy the **Application ID** from the confirmation page

**Security:** Your credentials are encrypted and stored locally in Home Assistant.

After setup, add your banks via **Add bank** on the Finance integration page.

reconfigure.title: Replace Enable Banking credentials
reconfigure.description:
Enter the new Application ID and private key. Your connected banks stay as they are.

The registered redirect URL must be: `{redirect_url}`
